falsePositives.message: Criteria for the high/medium/low rating and the CRO's approval basis are not defined.
Content areas are listed, but no approval criteria or conditions for rejection or rework are defined.
Only an implied one-time trigger; the column says 'Per change', so state whether reassessment on change is required.
No review criteria are defined, such as regulatory changes, incidents or RACI gaps to be checked.
Only a frequency word; no fixed timing such as a month or deadline relative to the policy cycle.
The DPO's approval criteria are not defined, for example a valid legal basis or licence covering AI training.
The description does not say what evidence of the alert and its review is kept, or where.
Calculation and alerting are concrete, but 'reviewed' does not say what the reviewer does or what happens after review.
The alert trigger is defined, but there is no deadline for reviewing the alert after it is raised.
A function is named, not a role; name the role performing and signing off the review, e.g. Head of Internal Audit.
'Material' is not defined; state the criteria or inventory that determines which AI systems are in scope.
Only a frequency word; no fixed timing or deadline for fieldwork or for reporting to the Audit Committee.
Standard is referenced but completeness criteria and handling of deficiencies are not defined; name the standard and rejection rule.
No approval criteria are defined, e.g. minimum answers or conditions for rejection or escalation.
Owner "Legal Counsel" looks like a person's name. Use a role, so the control survives staff changes.
Monthly cadence is stated but not the deadline or trigger, e.g. within X business days after month-end.
Blocks occur in real time, but the weekly review lacks a fixed day or deadline.
